title: #1 Resume Myth To Ignore
description:
Believing certain resume myths can prevent you from seeing the results you want in your job search.

Teal member Oshen Davidson reveals how the #1 resume myth—a one-page resume is the only option—held her back from interviews and how going against this advice unlocked 6X more opportunities.
